# 3 Axial Skyrmions
- The reflection described flips the sign of only one pion field, so the relative phase here differs by π from the convention in refs.[3, 12, 7], where the antiSkyrmion is obtained by reversing all three pion fields, and this choice aligns more naturally with the analogous monopole configuration.  
- According to (3.10), the profile function vanishes at a radius s/2 from the Skyrmion (or antiSkyrmion) center, allowing the Skyrmion and antiSkyrmion to be joined continuously with the fields matching the vacuum outside their cores.  
- Beyond the simple ansatz (3.7) for initial conditions, more elaborate starts were employed using the rational map ansatz [11] with an axially symmetric charge-n map.
